source_evidence: Exact player 'I’d rather fenar approach without weapons' requests Fenar rather than Mara perform the proposed reversible unarmed approach test. Fenar voluntarily agrees, leaves her mechanically carried greataxe (Double-Claw Rend visual reskin), two handaxes and four javelins in Mara's temporary custody at (0,70), not abandoned or transferred as property. Rage and Shift remain inactive; no Beast weapons manifested; no resource spent. She approaches alone visibly unarmed, hands open, V/Cirren/Mara stay outside, armed V's existing sword stays visible. D342~16:52 Fenar walks along track to (0,105), immediately before the arch and between the two guards' approaches, stops without crossing into inner courtyard. Fixed original gate duty permits visibly unarmed visitors: neither guardian attacks nor moves to bar her individually, both continue warning the visibly armed party behind her; Fenar pauses and tells party they aren't stopping her. This is actual evidence of differential behavior, not yet a completed passage, reprogramming, pacification, disarm requirement for all party members, title or absolute safety. No initiative or RNG: deterministic programmed response from preexisting prep dm-estate-ancestry.md @6b212651690e00944bf9db891893a5fcd6749167. No extra V action or companion passage, HP/time/food/gold changes beyond brief test and temporary gear custody. V next decision.
